news.title: Nasa selects Jeff Bezos’s Blue Origin for first of three uncrewed lunar missions
news.description: NASA has unveiled ambitious plans for three uncrewed lunar missions in 2026 to kickstart construction of a $20 billion moon base, choosing Blue Origin to conduct the very first launch slated for this fall.

news.title: Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket explodes in massive fireball during prelaunch test
news.description: During a critical static fire test at Cape Canaveral, Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket suffered a major anomaly resulting in a massive explosion, complicating upcoming mission timelines for Amazon's Project Kuiper LEO satellites.

news.title: ULA launches 29 Amazon Leo satellites on Atlas 5 rocket from Cape Canaveral
news.description: United Launch Alliance successfully launched its second-to-last Atlas 5 rocket booked by Amazon, carrying 29 low-Earth-orbit internet satellites into space from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station.

news.title: FAA requires SpaceX-led mishap investigation before resumption of Starship launches
news.description: The Federal Aviation Administration has grounded further Starship test flights pending an official investigation into the recent Starship Flight 12, where one of the vacuum-optimized Raptor engines shut down early.
